tail:
Batch 32 is authored: **17 A-page items and 3 examples**, with supplier dependencies and item levels aligned to the full in-run graph. The forward-discretization theorem is level 7 because it depends on the batch-25 error-chain item at level 6; batch 32 remains scheduling level 2.

All 20 assigned items have current `ready` records. Strict proof-contract, precheck, proof-layout, focused dependency, render and coverage checks pass. Source retrieval is verified for all four sources, including [Clason](https://imsc.uni-graz.at/clason/preprints/InverseNotes.pdf), [Hansen](https://people.compute.dtu.dk/pcha/DIP/chap5.pdf), and [Teschl](https://www.uomustansiriyah.edu.iq/media/lectures/9/9_2018_12_07!10_23_44_AM.pdf).

The **full-run** dependency-level check remains blocked outside batch 32: its latest snapshot reports 112 empty scaffold inventories and 20 level mismatches across batches 35, 40, 48 and 54. No batch-32 item is among those errors; their exact details are recorded in the notes for owner reconciliation. Readiness records are authoring evidence, not independent approval.
